solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Silent one taken into consideration

indicators.note: the word for one is taken into the word for consideration, so it sits inside it

parts.note: tact is consideration for others' feelings
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A quiet person whose views are nonetheless taken into account.
explanation.definitionFit: Tacit agreement is understood without being spoken, so the word means unspoken or silent.

clue.text: Section of church wants new agency to be set up before one month

indicators.note: before means the reversed piece comes ahead of the month
set up in a down clue means the letters are read upwards, reversed

parts.note: art is agency, a means of achieving something
Sept is short for September

explanation.surface: A church needs a new agency set up before a month passes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be set up' turns N ART into TRAN.
explanation.definitionFit: A transept is the arm of a cross-shaped church running across the nave.

clue.text: Conservative girl exposed rising social struggle

parts.note: a lass is a girl

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the word reads upwards, reversed

parts.note: raw skin is exposed

explanation.surface: A Tory girl reveals an upsurge of social conflict.
explanation.definitionFit: Class war is conflict between social classes, a struggle in society.

clue.text: Still, succeeded to stop amateurish perverted film

indicators.note: to stop means the pieces plug a gap in the mixed letters, inside them
perverted means the letters of amateurish are twisted out of shape

parts.note: even and still both mean yet, as in 'even more'

explanation.surface: Even so, a successor halted an amateurish and depraved movie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perverted' makes THESAMURAI from amateurish; 'to stop' puts EVEN S between THE and SAMURAI.
explanation.definitionFit: The Seven Samurai is Akira Kurosawa's 1954 Japanese movie classic.

clue.text: Divine messenger in a shift held by both hands

indicators.note: the pieces from 'a shift' are held between the two letters standing for the hands

parts.note: R for right hand and L for left hand
a shift is a change

explanation.surface: A heavenly messenger being passed between two hands during a change of shift.
explanation.definitionFit: An archangel is a high-ranking angel, and angels are divine messengers in scripture.

clue.text: Flower revealed by fairly green unknown botanist in seconds

indicators.note: in seconds means take the second letter of each of the four following words

explanation.surface: A flower found by a rather inexperienced, little-known botanist in moments.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flower' is something that flows, a river: the Arno runs through Florence.
explanation.definitionFit: Crosswords read flower as a thing that flows, and the Arno is an Italian river.

clue.text: Trust her to finance new housing for daughter

indicators.note: housing means the mixed letters hold the abbreviation for daughter inside
new means the letters are formed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An instruction to trust a woman to fund new housing for her daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'housing' looks like homes for the daughter, but it signals that D goes inside the letters that 'new' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: A confidante is a woman whom one trusts with secrets.

clue.text: For some, football trials near usual ground

indicators.note: ground as in ground down, crushed, so the letters are broken up and remade

explanation.surface: For some players, football trials take place near their usual ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ground' looks like a sports ground but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Australian rules is a code of football played in Australia, so football only for some people.

clue.text: Easily controlled insurgent leaking only the core material

indicators.note: only the core material means only the inner letters of these two words are used, concealed within them

explanation.surface: A rebel leaking just the central documents.
explanation.definitionFit: A gentle animal is docile, tame and easy to manage.

clue.text: Posh boy and girl

parts.note: a lad is a boy
Ida is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A smart pair: a boy and a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: La-di-da describes affectedly upper-class, pretentious manners.

clue.text: Begin play about heartless man pursuing a classical king

indicators.note: pursuing means coming after, so the rest follows the letter from 'a'
the phrase for starting a match goes around the trimmed man

parts.note: 'game on' is the call to begin play

indicators.note: heartless means the middle letter of the word man is removed

parts.note: taken as written before its middle letter goes

explanation.surface: An instruction to start a game featuring a heartless man chasing an ancient monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Begin play' is the call 'game on'; 'heartless' takes the middle letter out of man before the call goes around it.
explanation.definitionFit: Agamemnon was the king of Mycenae who led the Greeks at Troy in classical legend.

clue.text: Fellows about to cover opening of York Assembly

indicators.note: the reversed fellows are wrapped around the initial of York, covering it
about signals that the word for fellows is turned round

parts.note: dons are university fellows

indicators.note: opening of means just the first letter of York

explanation.surface: University fellows are about to attend the opening of a gathering in York.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns DONS into SNOD, and 'to cover' wraps that round Y.
explanation.definitionFit: A synod is an assembly of church clergy, such as the General Synod meeting at York.

clue.text: One employed to oversee tenders

parts.note: tenders here are nurses, those who tend the sick; a senior nurse in charge of a ward supervises them

explanation.surface: Someone hired to supervise bids, or perhaps small boats attending a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'tenders' suggests bids or boats, but here it means people who tend patients.
explanation.definitionFit: In British hospitals the senior nurse running a ward holds this title and supervises the other nurses.

clue.text: As vulnerable people may be hoodwinked about sport

indicators.note: the word for hoodwinked goes about, around, the sport

parts.note: hoodwinked means misled
RU is rugby union

explanation.surface: Vulnerable people may be fooled when it comes to sport.
explanation.definitionFit: The defenceless are often governed badly by those in power over them.

clue.text: Serious complaint made by boss taking siesta badly

indicators.note: badly means the letters of the two words are arranged wrongly, into a new order

explanation.surface: A serious grievance results when the boss takes a poorly timed nap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complaint' suggests a grievance, but it is an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: Asbestosis is a grave lung disease caused by inhaling asbestos fibres; complaint means ailment.

clue.text: Sharp lawyers prepared items for petition

indicators.note: prepared means the letters of the two words are made up into something new

explanation.surface: Clever attorneys drafted documents for a legal petition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'petition' suggests a legal plea, but here it is a prayer to God.
explanation.definitionFit: Prayer shawls are worn in Jewish worship, and petition is another word for prayer.

clue.text: It may precede ban of offensive term for women reported on the tube

indicators.note: in a down clue on means placed above the next piece
reported means the word is as it is spoken, spelt another way

parts.note: hoes is a derogatory slang term for women
a pipe is a tube

explanation.surface: A ban on a slur about women heard on the London Underground, the Tube.
explanation.walkthrough: A hosepipe ban is a British summer drought restriction on garden hoses.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain the phrase 'hosepipe ban' is common, so the word comes before ban.

clue.text: Club lounge disrupted by bishop boxing duke

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

indicators.note: boxing means enclosing the duke's letter inside the mixed letters
disrupted means the letters of lounge are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A club lounge disturbed when a bishop takes a swing at a duke.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Club' looks like a social club, but it is a cudgel. 'disrupted' gives LUGEON, and 'boxing' puts D inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A bludgeon is a heavy stick used as a weapon, a cudgel or club.

clue.text: Must gorilla regularly produce something smelly?

parts.note: a must is something essential

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of gorilla

explanation.surface: Does a gorilla have to keep producing a stink?
explanation.definitionFit: An essential oil is a fragrant plant extract used in perfume and aromatherapy, so it smells.

clue.text: Heroes go here since trail turned north

parts.note: as and since both mean because

indicators.note: turned north in a down clue means read upwards, reversed

parts.note: to trail is to drag

explanation.surface: Heroes go this way, since the trail turned north.
explanation.definitionFit: In Norse myth Asgard is the realm of the gods, home of Valhalla where fallen warriors go.

clue.text: Renaissance painter picked up second panel

indicators.note: picked up means heard, so the painter's name gives a word with a similar spoken form

parts.note: Albrecht Durer was a German Renaissance artist

explanation.surface: A Renaissance artist chose a second panel for a painting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'panel' looks like a painted board, but it is a jury.
explanation.definitionFit: A jury is a panel of people chosen to decide a verdict.

clue.text: One who's very close to us males, mostly moving

indicators.note: moving means the letters are moved around into a new order
mostly means males loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Someone intimate with a group of men, who keep moving about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims MALES to MALE; 'moving' rearranges TO US MALE.
explanation.definitionFit: A soulmate is the person one feels most deeply connected to, an intimate partner.

clue.text: Run into one consumed by hate? The complete opposite

indicators.note: the letter for run is put into the word for a hateful one

parts.note: a fiend is a demon full of malice
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A runaway into a hateful person, then a twist saying it is the opposite.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition points back at the fiend of the wordplay: the answer is its complete opposite, a companion rather than an enemy.
explanation.definitionFit: A pal or ally is the reverse of a malicious demon who hates you.

clue.text: Considerate character

definitions.meaning: considerate means thoughtful and kindly toward others
character as in sort or type, as in 'of that ilk'

explanation.definitionFit: Kind means caring as an adjective and type or sort as a noun.

clue.text: Fling last bit of letter from mail, say

indicators.note: from means the chosen letter is taken away from the word for mail

parts.note: chain mail is an example of armour

indicators.note: last bit of means the final letter of letter

explanation.surface: Throwing away the last part of a letter from the post.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mail' looks like post, but it is chain mail, a kind of armour.
explanation.definitionFit: An amour is a love affair, often a brief one, much like a fling.

clue.text: Image portrayed by even one long sentence

parts.note: still and even both mean yet, as in 'even better'
a life sentence is a long jail term

explanation.surface: A picture painted by an even prison sentence.
explanation.definitionFit: A still life is a painting of inanimate objects such as fruit or flowers, a kind of picture.

clue.text: Small girl having entered popped off out

indicators.note: the small girl has entered the word for popped off, sitting inside it

parts.note: popped off is slang for died
a miss is a girl

explanation.surface: A little girl came in and then promptly went out again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' is the definition in the cricket sense: a batsman who is out has been dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket a batsman given out has been sent from the field, the same as being sent away.

clue.text: Hank Williams finally getting school punishment in report?

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of Williams
in report means the word is said aloud and spelt by its sound

parts.note: the cane was a beating once given in British schools

explanation.surface: The country singer Hank Williams finally caned at school, according to reports.
explanation.walkthrough: Hank Williams is a singer, but 'Hank' alone is the definition; S plus a word sounding like cane gives the whole.
explanation.definitionFit: A hank of yarn and a skein are both coiled lengths of thread wound loosely.
